title: Partner compute cascade
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for routing public-good tasks across a sub-2ms edge shim, Fireworks AI multi-LoRA specialist adapters, Baseten <= 2,000,000 TPM fenced swarms, Modal isolated sandboxes and QLoRA fine-tuning, and Meta Muse / Llama models with honest local_verified vs live_api receipts.
boundaries: Local dry-run receipts report mode local_verified explicitly and never masquerade as live cloud API runs when partner keys are absent.
Modal container sandboxes enforce block_network=true, zero forwarded host secrets and read-only pack mounts before checking untrusted bundles.
Baseten swarm workers verify lease TTL and monotonic fencing tokens pre-flight and pace requests strictly within <= 2,000,000 tokens per minute.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for tiered partner compute routing, Modal QLoRA and sandbox verification, Baseten 2M TPM swarms and Fireworks multi-LoRA rubric checks

value.lets_workers: Route public-good tasks across a 5-tier compute cascade starting at a zero-token sub-2ms edge shim, escalating through Fireworks AI specialist multi-LoRA adapters with Sinan Ozdemir distinct-adapter rubric checks, Baseten <= 2,000,000 TPM async token-bucket swarms with fenced lease checks, Modal isolated container sandboxes and serverless QLoRA runs on Meta Muse-Glimmer-30B or Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, and frontier Meta Muse Spark escalation.

flow.when: Verify Modal sandbox isolation invariants, holdout-safe QLoRA trace formatting and peak GPU VRAM math before any training or container run.
Schedule parallel worker claims under <= 2,000,000 TPM sliding-window pacing with pre-flight fencing-token and lease-TTL gates.
Select a specialist LoRA drafter behind a sub-2ms edge shim and verify structured JSON outputs with a distinct rubric-verifier adapter.

value.worked_example: Made-up Muse-Glimmer-30B QLoRA, sandbox and Fireworks statute-citation bundle recomputed in test_partner_cascade.py: confirms 19.702 GiB peak VRAM fits within 92% of A100-40GB, validates sandbox isolation, selects statute-citation-extractor-lora and passes distinct-adapter rubric verification.

nouns.title: Guardrail: stamp local_verified vs live_api honestly on every partner compute receipt
nouns.category_reason: Prevents local dry-run math or loopback mock tests from being mistaken for live Modal, Baseten, Fireworks or Meta API calls.

value.rule: Partner compute runners stamp mode local_verified whenever MODAL_TOKEN_ID, BASETEN_API_KEY, FIREWORKS_API_KEY or META_API_KEY are absent or uninvoked, and never fabricate live_api receipts.
value.how_it_is_checked: run_full_cascade_report inspects credential presence and records mode local_verified explicitly.

nouns.title: Guardrail: enforce <= 2,000,000 TPM sliding-window pacing and pre-flight lease fencing
nouns.category_reason: Stops stale workers or burst fanout tasks from burning partner credits or tripping uncontrolled rate cascades.

value.rule: Swarm claims with stale fencing tokens or remaining lease TTL below min_safe_lease_seconds abort pre-flight with zero tokens burned, while active claims stay within <= 2,000,000 tokens per 60-second sliding window.
value.how_it_is_checked: BasetenSwarmClient checks observe_fence and AsyncTokenBucket2M before dispatching and preserves HTTP 429 retry records in attempts.

nouns.title: Guardrail: specialist LoRA drafters never verify their own rubric checklist
nouns.category_reason: Applies Sinan Ozdemir multi-LoRA rubric verification so drafter errors, missing citations or PII leaks escalate safely.

value.rule: Structured specialist LoRA outputs require verification by a distinct verifier adapter checking required schema fields, grounded citations, zero PII patterns and a non-empty human_only boundary.
value.how_it_is_checked: FireworksMultiLoraRouter.verify_rubric rejects drafter_adapter == verifier_adapter and escalates failed candidates.

nouns.title: Specification: 5-tier public-good compute cascade across edge shim, Fireworks, Baseten, Modal and Meta models
nouns.category_reason: Documents tier ordering, partner credit envelopes ($100 x 3) and Meta open-weight model targets.

cascade_tiers: tier_1_fireworks_multilora (Llama-3.1-8B specialist drafters + Llama-3.3-70B rubric verifier)
tier_2_baseten_2m_tpm_swarm (<=2,000,000 TPM async token-bucket Llama-3.3-70B parallel workers)
tier_3_modal_qlora_and_sandbox (isolated container sandbox + Muse-Glimmer-30B / Llama-3.2-3B QLoRA)

nouns.title: Deterministic VRAM, sandbox isolation, 2M TPM pacing and rubric escalation rules
nouns.category_reason: Zero-call local checks executed before spending GPU time or API credits.

qlora_trace_gates: no raw SSN or email PII pattern
value.rubric_escalation_rule: escalate_to_baseten_or_modal_tier on missing citations, PII pattern, missing human_only or self-verification

nouns.title: Tool card: Modal QLoRA and sandbox validator, Baseten 2M TPM swarm client and Fireworks multi-LoRA router
nouns.category_reason: Tested Python standard-library package with optional Modal/HTTP runtime entrypoints pinned by path and digest.

value.name: Partner compute cascade
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only for dry-run verification, loopback 2M TPM swarm test and simulator; optional modal CLI and partner API keys for cloud execution.
does: Validates Modal container sandbox isolation, holdout-safe QLoRA datasets and 4-bit NF4 VRAM budgets for Muse-Glimmer-30B and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct.
Enforces <= 2,000,000 TPM sliding-window token pacing, HTTP 429 Retry-After backoff and pre-flight lease fencing across async worker claims.
Routes structured tasks behind a sub-2ms edge shim to Fireworks specialist LoRA adapters with distinct-adapter rubric checks.
does_not: Fabricate live_api receipts when credentials are unset, forward host secrets into sandboxes or exceed authorized credit budgets.

nouns.title: Template: partner compute pre-flight and multi-LoRA rubric verification receipt

value.describes: honest verification mode, QLoRA peak VRAM fit, sandbox isolation validity, selected specialist LoRA adapter and rubric pass status

nouns.title: Worked example input: Muse-Glimmer-30B QLoRA config, isolated sandbox spec and housing statute citation check
nouns.category_reason: Made-up partner compute pre-flight bundle recomputed by test_partner_cascade.py.

value.prompt: Extract public municipal housing statute section citations with exact line numbers

candidate_output.human_only: Licensed municipal housing counsel verifies applicability before advising tenants.

nouns.title: Worked example output: recomputed local_verified VRAM fit, sandbox check and rubric verdict

verbs.title: Validate Modal sandbox isolation, holdout-safe QLoRA traces and GPU VRAM fit
verbs.summary: Check isolated container sandbox flags, filter QLoRA training traces for PII and benchmark holdout overlap, and compute 4-bit NF4 peak VRAM before any GPU run.
verbs.outcome: Deterministic pre-flight receipt confirming sandbox safety, holdout separation and GPU VRAM margin.

slots.name: cascade_bundle
slots.description: Pin of QLoRA model configuration, trace batch and container sandbox spec.

steps: Run compute_qlora_vram_and_config, verify_sandbox_contract and format_traces_for_qlora on the input bundle.
Stamp mode local_verified when MODAL_TOKEN_ID is absent or dry-run validation is selected.

acceptance.check: Peak VRAM fits within 92% of target GPU memory and all four sandbox isolation flags hold.

verbs.title: Pace parallel fenced worker claims within Baseten's 2,000,000 TPM sliding window
network: HTTPS calls go only to the worker's configured Baseten inference endpoint during live runs; loopback mock verification uses localhost only and contacts no external host.
verbs.summary: Verify monotonic fencing tokens and remaining lease TTL pre-flight, then schedule async worker claims through a <= 2,000,000 TPM sliding-window token bucket with HTTP 429 backoff.
verbs.outcome: Fenced swarm receipt recording peak sliding-window token rate, zero-token stale-fence aborts and preserved retry history.

slots.name: swarm_claims
slots.description: Pin of fenced worker claim batch and token budget parameters.

steps: Reject claims with stale fencing tokens or insufficient remaining lease TTL before reserving tokens.
Acquire sliding-window capacity under <= 2,000,000 TPM, reconcile actual usage and preserve any 429 retry records.

acceptance.check: Peak 60-second window usage stays <= 2,000,000 tokens and stale-fenced claims burn zero tokens.

verbs.title: Route structured tasks behind a sub-2ms edge shim to specialist LoRAs with rubric checks
verbs.summary: Replay exact verified fingerprints in < 2 ms at zero token cost, select a Fireworks specialist LoRA drafter on cache miss and check candidate outputs with a distinct rubric verifier.
verbs.outcome: Conforming cascade receipt naming the selected adapter, sub-2ms shim status and distinct-adapter rubric verdict.

slots.name: routing_bundle
slots.description: Pin of structured prompt, required JSON fields and candidate specialist output.

steps: Run FireworksMultiLoraRouter.route_request to check sub-2ms memo replay or pick a specialist drafter.
Run FireworksMultiLoraRouter.verify_rubric with a distinct verifier adapter and escalate any failed candidate.

acceptance.check: Shim latency is < 2.0 ms, drafter != verifier and output validates against template.cascade-receipt.
